description: The agent types a skill can target, as the API values metadata.aws-devops-agent-skills.agent-types lists, comma-separated. A skill without that key installs as GENERIC, which loads it for every agent. Add a value here when DevOps Agent documents a new agent type: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/devopsagent/latest/userguide/about-aws-devops-agent-managing-assets.html
